text_block_list.text:
I brought North Flight, who hasn't been feeling her best lately,
to the shrine for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*... *exhale*... Phew.
That feels so nice~

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's because we're up so high,
but the air feels lighter and clearer
than down below."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here... Trainer,
shall we pay our respects to the gods before heading home?
choice_data_list: Visiting the shrine... not to make a wish?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a greeting.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right now... how should I put it,
rather than having my wish granted,
I feel like I'd rather just be watched over...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...I've been aware lately that my spirits have been down..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Still, this is my problem to deal with.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In order to become my own shining self...
I have to be the one to spur myself on.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So, I want to ask God...
to watch over me
so that I can do my best again.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, not bad.
I don't dislike that way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan!
Hello, what an unusual place to run into you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Just felt like it while I was running.
Since I'm here, I'll come along for that 'greeting' to the deity too."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, God!
Keep your eyes glued right here and watch me!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll crush every last one of them with my running... and show 'em what it means to be the strongest!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Hearing Pokke-chan's straightforward and powerful "greeting" made me feel a bit...",},
  {"id": 42, "en": "...Fufu. You don't have to type it in now.
Instead, tell me right here.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Oh God! 
I'll do my absolute best 
so I can become a sparkling version of myself too!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Please watch over me, okay?

North Flight declared cheerfully.
It seemed she had returned
to her usual lively self.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. Now that I think about it,
this counts as asking a favor too, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This won't do.
I end up relying on you after all... phew.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I need to take a good, hard look at myself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I'm sorry for making you worry...

Perhaps because she was overthinking things,
it didn't seem to offer much of a change of pace...
